title: Identification of 3-arylquinoxalin-2(1H)-one derivatives targeting BRD4 BD1 as efficient anticancer agents.
authors: Cheng, Zhuo; Zou, Zhiru; Xin, Meixiu; Wu, Shaoqiang; Lu, Guoqing; Du, Zhibo; Chen, Xinwei; Chen, Guanbing; Cai, Yuchen; Zou, Yong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究BRD4蛋白小分子抑制剂的设计与抗癌活性，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，且方法为湿实验与分子对接，与本课题无关。
abstract: BRD4 is a key epigenetic reader protein critically involved in the growth and proliferation of both hematological malignancies and solid tumors. Developing selective BRD4 BD1 inhibitors with novel scaffolds has emerged as a promising strategy to address the limitations of current agents. Through a scaffold fusion approach, a series of 3-arylquinoxalin-2(1H)-one derivatives with promising BRD4 BD1 inhibitory activity were designed and synthesized. The optimized compound B12 demonstrated excellent BRD4 BD1 inhibitory activity (IC(50) = 0.82 muM) and high selectivity over BRD4 BD2 (22-fold). B12 could effectively suppress the migration and proliferation of A549 cells (IC(50) = 0.73 muM). Mechanistic studies revealed that B12 treatment could effectively downregulate c-myc and anti-apoptotic protein expression, increase DNA damage, elevate ROS levels, reduce mitochondrial membrane potential, and trigger apoptosis. Molecular docking suggested that B12 selectively binds to the active site of BRD4 BD1 through key hydrogen bonds with Asn140 and Asp144. Moreover, B12 showed favorable pharmacokinetic properties. Taken together, our research highlights that the 3-arylquinoxalin-2(1H)-one scaffold could serve as a valuable backbone for BRD4 inhibition and B12 is a promising candidate for further investigation.
abstract_zh: BRD4是一种关键的表观遗传阅读器蛋白，在血液系统恶性肿瘤和实体瘤的生长与增殖中发挥重要作用。开发具有新型骨架的选择性BRD4 BD1抑制剂已成为应对现有药物局限性的有前景策略。通过骨架融合方法，设计并合成了一系列具有良好BRD4 BD1抑制活性的3-芳基喹喔啉-2(1H)-酮衍生物。优化后的化合物B12表现出优异的BRD4 BD1抑制活性（IC(50) = 0.82 μM）和对BRD4 BD2的高选择性（22倍）。B12能有效抑制A549细胞的迁移和增殖（IC(50) = 0.73 μM）。机制研究表明，B12处理能有效下调c-myc和抗凋亡蛋白表达，增加DNA损伤，升高ROS水平，降低线粒体膜电位，并触发凋亡。分子对接提示B12通过与Asn140和Asp144的关键氢键选择性结合BRD4 BD1的活性位点。此外，B12显示出良好的药代动力学特性。综上所述，我们的研究强调3-芳基喹喔啉-2(1H)-酮骨架可作为BRD4抑制的有价值母核，且B12是值得进一步研究的候选化合物。
